newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian 728-day bond priced average 98.26 pct.
newsitem.headline: Russian 728-day bond priced average 98.26 pct.

text.p: The average price of a new issue of 728-day OFZ interest-bearing government bonds was 98.26 percent at an auction on Wednesday, the Central Bank said.
Dealers had forecast the price would be in a 95.9-99.0 percent range.
The 24011 bond, maturing on March 31, 1999, the closest maturity date to the new issue, closed at 100.15 percent on Tuesday to yield 36.04 percent annually.
Full details of the auction follow:

On April 30 the Finance Ministry raised about 5.32 trillion roubles in Treasury bills, taking total proceeds from today's auctions to 6.87 trillion roubles. It has also repaid about 6.87 trillion roubles in maturing 224-day T-bills (series 23050).
